matching_criterion: Atrial fibrillation (new onset, with rapid ventricular rate). Any wording that names atrial fibrillation counts as correct; sinus tachycardia, atrial flutter or supraventricular tachycardia without naming atrial fibrillation does not.

management_reference.management: Oral anticoagulation prevents ischaemic stroke in AF; stroke risk is assessed with the CHA2DS2-VA score.
management_reference.source_quote: The effectiveness of oral anticoagulation in preventing ischaemic stroke in patients with AF is well-documented

management_reference.management: Antiplatelet therapy alone is not indicated for stroke prevention in AF.
management_reference.source_quote: Antiplatelet therapies alone are not indicated for stroke prevention in AF

management_reference.management: Manage comorbidities and risk factors (hypertension, diabetes, obesity, alcohol, physical activity) with set targets.
management_reference.source_quote: The guidelines set precise targets for managing AF-associated conditions and risk factors for all those comorbidities with a sufficient evidence base

management_reference.management: Use the structured AF-CARE approach: comorbidity and risk factors, avoid stroke, reduce symptoms by rate and rhythm control, evaluation and dynamic reassessment.
management_reference.source_quote: Comorbidity and risk factor management, [A] Avoid stroke and thromboembolism, [R] Reduce symptoms by rate and rhythm control, [E] Evaluation and dynamic reassessment

management_scoring_note: Only items with a verified source quote are scored; general good practice that the article does not state is not scored.
